comparator.name: Health Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The adopted OER, article 11.3, specifies ten compulsory first-year 6-EC units and eight second-year 6-EC units; article 11.4 requires one 6-EC choice in second-year period 5 from Mental Health, Planetary Health, or Diversity and Equity and one 6-EC choice in period 6 from Management van Innovaties, Voedingsleer en Onderzoek, or Implementatieonderzoek. Article 12.1 establishes at least 30 EC in the third-year minor/free-choice semester. Thus 150 EC of year-one, year-two and third-year free-choice structure is securely credit-bearing. The currently taught third-year table lists Epidemiologie & Biostatistiek III at 6 EC and Bachelorstage (GZW) at 18 EC, with other 6-EC year-three electives, but the OER also says the old curriculum is being phased out from 2025–26. Its new-cohort prerequisite section explicitly names 'Methodologie 5: zelf onderzoek doen' with course code still unknown. The prospective programme page says the new third year includes a minor, a three-month research placement and bachelor thesis, and names 'De gezondheidswetenschapper als professional', while the current OER gives no new-cohort credit allocation for those latter elements. Treating the current old-cohort third-year 24 EC as the complete 2026 entrant's future 30 EC would miss at least 6 EC and potentially misrepresent the new methods, professional and thesis work. The study guide confirms Dutch instruction and 180 EC but the accessible programme summary provides no future-year component table. OER 9.1: new-cohort Methodologie 3 requires Methodologie 2 or the specified older equivalents; Methodologie 5 requires Methodologie 3 or old Epidemiology/Biostatistics II, but its code and credits are not given. Older-cohort Epidemiology III and placement prerequisites are not substituted. OER 10.4: zero-credit Dutch diagnostic/refresher gates AB_1326. OER 12.1: open study at least 30 EC, individual package at least 12 EC level 300 and at most 6 EC level 100; board approval required, with named eligible minor exceptions under 12.2. Abroad permits at most one 6-EC level-400 course excluded from a subsequent master. OER 11.6 delegates attendance to course manuals and thesis/stage rules to the applicable guidelines. BSA 42 first-year EC. Professional skills and portfolio development are integrated across the programme; no extra EC invented.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Health Sciences studies population health and wellbeing through biological, behavioral, social, environmental and policy perspectives. Students investigate health inequalities, prevention and the organisation of healthcare, with research and community-based learning.
